title: 5999--Anesthesia Carts Service Agreement - Drager
agency_path: VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.246-NETWORK CONTRACTING OFFICE 6 (36C246)
detail_text: This is a Pre-solicitation notice. This Pre-solicitation notice is not a request for formal proposals or quotes. Solicitation, 36C24626Q0431, will be issued on or about 9 April 2026. The Department of Veterans Affairs, Richmond VA Medical has a purchase for the Drager Anesthesia Carts Service for the Richmond VA Medical Center located in Richmond, Virginia. This acquisition will be solicited unrestricted utilizing full and open completion. The applicable NAICS Code is 811210 with a size standard of $34 Million. All correspondence and responses shall be via e-mail to cedric.frasier@va.gov . Telephone requests for information or questions will NOT be accepted. Offerors are responsible for downloading all documents including amendments from Contracting Opportunities at sam.gov website without further notification from the Contracting Officer.
